data.animaCaption: With the sleeves of her black shirt rolled neatly above her wrists under a dark canvas barista apron, she gently stirs the upper chamber of a glass siphon brewer in calm concentration. Warm pendant light and the tiny blue-amber burner flame glint off the glass, rising steam, and her focused golden eyes.
data.promptProse: Framed across a gleaming glass vacuum siphon coffee brewer set in the near foreground on a dark wood counter, Shiki Natsume prepares a late-night brew after closing time. Wearing a crisp black shirt with rolled sleeves, a vintage brown canvas barista apron, and a thin leather watch, she holds a bamboo paddle to stir the dark swirling coffee in the upper glass cylinder, her amber eyes lowered in tranquil focus. A low warm pendant lamp and the glowing burner flame beneath the flask carve golden highlights through the rising steam against the shadowed shelves of Café Stella.
data.story: 打烊后的咖啡馆安静得能听见虹吸壶咕嘟冒泡的声音。挽起黑衬衫袖口的夏目神情专注地用竹棒轻搅上壶液面，暖黄吊灯在玻璃壁和蒸汽间折射出温柔光泽——「最后这一壶是给你留的，趁热喝，凉了会发酸。」
